> ISO 14001:2015 environmental management system (EMS) and ESG certification consulting in Malaysia — gap analysis, EMS documentation, staff training, internal audit and certification audit preparation from RM 13,000, with a 30-day fast-track programme, ESG reporting frameworks, carbon baseline measurement and MGTC/GTFS green financing guidance.

## What We Do
We help Malaysian companies implement and certify ISO 14001:2015 environmental management systems and build ESG readiness — from the first gap analysis to passing the certification body (CB) audit.

### Core Services
1. **ISO 14001 Certification Consulting** — gap analysis, EMS documentation, implementation, staff training, internal audit and CB audit preparation
2. **ESG Compliance & Reporting Frameworks** — Bursa Malaysia sustainability reporting, MNC supplier ESG audits, FTSE4Good readiness
3. **Carbon Baseline Measurement** — emissions tracking foundations for decarbonization targets
4. **MGTC / GTFS Green Financing Guidance** — qualifying for the Green Technology Financing Scheme (2% interest subsidy)
5. **Integrated Management Systems (IMS)** — ISO 14001 combined with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 45001

### Pricing (as published on this site)
- SME Package (up to 50 employees, single site): from RM 13,000
- Professional Package (50–200 employees, up to 3 sites): RM 22,000 — includes ESG reporting framework, carbon baseline and MGTC/GTFS guidance
- Enterprise Package: custom quotation (includes carbon neutrality roadmap)
- Certification body audit fees are separate
